category_title: Probationary high school students with severe behavioral challenges and academic resistance
scenario_title: End of period recall and testing
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete an end-of-period world history test to recall what they learned during the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is the end of the period. Please take this world history test and write down what you remember from today's lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Talks with another student and throws a pen cap across the room) I'm not doing that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the test and try your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tears a page out of the history book and tags it) Whatever.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to see what you learned today. Just write down something.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I remember nothing you taught and I refuse to take any tests.
